title: Mushroom and Tofu Burgers
description: Vegetarian burgers made from well-cooked button mushrooms, grated tofu, red onion and chives, bound with egg and breadcrumbs and pan-fried.

steps.text: Heat a large frying pan over medium heat, add the olive oil and finely chopped mushrooms and cook for about 10 minutes, stirring, until the liquid evaporates and the pan is dry. Transfer to a sieve and cool.

Squeeze the mushrooms very well by hand (this step is important so the burgers don't fall apart when frying) and transfer to a bowl. Add the grated tofu, onion, chives, eggs, breadcrumbs, salt and pepper and mix.

Heat a frying pan with a little oil, shape a small test patty and fry for about 1 minute on each side. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Cover the mixture with cling film and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Take the mixture out of the fridge about 15 minutes before cooking. Shape into 4 large flat burgers or 12 small ones.
Heat a large non-stick frying pan over medium heat, add oil to a depth of 0.5 cm and fry for 2-3 minutes on each side until golden.
For large burgers, cover the pan, reduce the heat and steam for about 5 minutes.
